name: PGMMV-decrypt
target: Pixel Game Maker MV encrypted resource format

summary.en: Adds encrypted-resource decoding to the open-source PGMMV Linux player, using algorithms adapted from the existing MIT-licensed pgmm_decrypt project.
summary.zh-CN: 为开源 PGMMV Linux 播放器补充加密资源解码，算法改编自已有 MIT 许可项目 pgmm_decrypt。

rea.en: The implementation commit explicitly says REA and Ghidra checked the resource algorithms against the official player; detailed tool records are not provided.
rea.zh-CN: 实现提交明确说明使用 REA 与 Ghidra 对照官方播放器核验资源算法，但未提供详细工具记录。

limitations.en: This is resource-format compatibility work, not recovery of the whole player; games must be supplied separately, and Windows DLL plugins remain unsupported.
limitations.zh-CN: 成果是资源格式兼容，并非恢复完整播放器；游戏须另行提供，仍不支持 Windows DLL 插件。
